question: Will the U.S. U-6 underemployment rate (BLS, seasonally adjusted) for April 2025 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2025-04-15) be above 7.6%, its value for December 2024?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2025-01-15 (December 2024), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
